rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things belonging to or characteristic of the sea.

example.english: Marine organisms are especially sensitive to pollution.
example.traditional: 海洋生物對污染特別敏感。
example.jyutping: hoi2 joeng4 sang1 mat6 deoi3 wu1 jim5 dak6 bit6 man5 gam2

rows.note: Use this for shipping, operations, or equipment located on or intended for use at sea.

example.english: This marine equipment is for cargo ships.
example.traditional: 呢套海上設備係畀貨船用嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hoi2 soeng6 cit3 bei6 hai6 bei2 fo3 syun4 jung6 ge3

rows.note: Use this in the maritime or shipping sphere, especially in technical and institutional contexts rather than for general oceanic features.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hai6 hoi2 si6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for underwater conditions or equipment, whether in seawater or freshwater.

example.english: This marine camera still works after being submerged for so long.
example.traditional: 水底攝影機浸咗咁耐都仲用得。
example.jyutping: seoi2 dai2 sip3 jing2 gei1 zam3 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 zung6 jung6 dak1
